title: OpenClaw v2026.5.18: What's New in May 2026 (Stable Rollup)
summary: OpenClaw shipped v2026.5.12 and v2026.5.18 in May 2026. Android realtime voice, new Plugin SDK CLI, Python debugging skill, Mac app redesign, and security hardening.
body_markdown: v2026.5.12 (May 14) focused on leaner installs, Telegram resilience, and plugin infrastructure. v2026.5.18 (May 18) is the stable rollup with Android voice, Mac redesign, new skills, and Codex improvements. Blink Claw users get it automatically.
